answer: The cornerstone is Candle packer wick coil seal recorded at the lye shed. Lay it as each wick coil is a measured candle yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must and the whole wall stands on real work. The price of one fake is 116 POA and 16 minutes; the price of 679 fakes is 78764 POA and 10864 minutes. The comet is the door, the onyx is the toll, and the lantern is the toll-keeper's book, open to anyone. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
